# Input
Single-line text entry. Pair with Label; never rely on placeholder as the label.

**When to use** — one line of text, email, number, search, password.
**When not to** — multi-line text (Textarea), choosing from a fixed set (no Select exists yet — log a candidate).

## Variants
`default` bordered, the standard field · `filled` on subtle or grouped surfaces · `unstyled` when the surrounding container owns the border (search bars, inline edit).

## Do
- Always render a Label with `htmlFor` matching the input `id`.
- Set `invalid` together with a visible error message wired via `aria-describedby`.
- Use `leadingIcon`/`trailingIcon` for affixes rather than absolutely positioning your own.

## Don't
- Don't use placeholder text as the only label.
- Don't put a currency or unit string in the placeholder — use the affix slots.
- Don't disable an input to show read-only content.

```tsx
<Label htmlFor="email" required>Email</Label>
<Input id="email" type="email" invalid={!!error} aria-describedby="email-err" />
```

## API
```tsx
import { Input } from "@atlas/ui-web/primitives/Input/Input"
```

**Input** — also accepts native `<input>` attributes (except size, prefix)
- ref: not forwarded — `ref` does not type-check; reach the element by `id`
- `variant?: InputVariant`
- `size?: InputSize`
- `invalid?: boolean`
- `loading?: boolean`
- `leadingIcon?: React.ReactNode`
- `trailingIcon?: React.ReactNode`
- `prefix?: React.ReactNode`
- `suffix?: React.ReactNode`
